pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/71804

I could be convinced that the chained rate limiter should use the largest queue count instead of the smallest.

Also, the NoopLimiter could technically keep track of the successful leases and update the stats for that property.

review_comments:
Is the theory here that when the `permitCount` is 0, the caller is just checking, so this isn't a "real" failed lease? I'm not sure I agree with this because I don't think this is the most straightforward way to interpret `TotalFailedLeases`.

I think we should probably count these. But if we don't, we should at least note this behavior in the `TotalSuccessfulLeases` and `TotalFailedLeases` doc comments.
Let's do this for `GetStatistics()` on all of our limiters.
Do we need a breaking change doc or was this API added in .NET 7?
It's a new API added in .NET 7: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/61788
